purpose: W II common-node degree lower bound, tungsten-domain publication routing, bibliographic infrastructure, and an exact unrelated-number collision control.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, navigation pages, and repeated copies of the same substantive source are provenance aliases, not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Substantive off-topic publications surfaced by search may be routed as reusable methodology/domain intelligence or negative-control material; search appearance never grants Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: Spectroscopic data for atomic tungsten transitions of interest in fusion plasma research
sources.authors: Pascal Quinet; P. Palmeri; Emile Biemont
sources.authority: Peer-reviewed Journal of Physics B publication; ORBi institutional full-text record
sources.note: Use as a tungsten transition-data and fusion-plasma diagnostic reference; cross-link against NIST ASD/critical compilations when selecting benchmark lines or validating radiative models.

sources.title: Tungsten spectroscopy relevant to the diagnostics of ITER divertor plasmas
sources.authors: Joel Clementson; P. Beiersdorfer; E. W. Magee; H. S. McLean; R. Dwood
sources.authority: Peer-reviewed Journal of Physics B publication; Lund University research record
sources.note: Use for low-charge-state tungsten EUV diagnostic design, Flexible Atomic Code comparison, grazing-incidence spectrometer methodology, and fusion/plasma partner-intelligence mapping.

sources.title: Compilation of Wavelengths and Energy Levels of Tungsten, W III through W LXXIV
sources.note: Extends the authoritative tungsten reference hierarchy beyond W I/W II; use to prevent ionization-stage conflation and to support plasma-state spectroscopy models.

sources.title: Atomic Energy Levels and Spectra Bibliographic Database
sources.authors: Alexander Kramida; William C. Martin; Arlene Musgrove; Karen J. Olsen; Joseph Reader; Edward B. Saloman
sources.note: Use as an authoritative bibliographic expansion mechanism for atomic-spectra source discovery and primary-source reconciliation, with discovered references retained as separate provenance objects.

sources.title: Photoionization of tungsten ions: experiment and theory for W2+ and W3+
sources.authors: B. M. McLaughlin; C. P. Ballance; S. Schippers; J. Hellhund; A. L. D. Kilcoyne; R. A. Phaneuf; A. Muller
sources.note: Use as an experiment-versus-theory benchmark for tungsten photoionization cross sections, spectral bandwidth effects, charge-state modeling, and advanced-light-source validation opportunities.

sources.title: Effects of a tungsten addition on the morphological evolution, spatial correlations, and temporal evolution of a model Ni-Al-Cr superalloy
sources.authors: Chantal K. Sudbrack; Tiffany D. Ziebell; Ronald D. Noebe; David N. Seidman
sources.note: Route into the materials database as empirical evidence for tungsten-alloy effects on precipitate morphology, hardness, coarsening kinetics, spatial correlation, and microstructural evolution.

sources.title: Detailed analysis of configuration interaction and calculation of radiative transition rates in seven times ionized tungsten (W VIII)
sources.note: Use for higher-charge tungsten configuration-interaction/radiative-rate modeling and as an ionization-stage-separated control against low-charge W II claims.

sources.title: Unrelated stock-forecast page containing numeric value 10592.485
sources.note: Exact unrelated-domain collision with the W II lower-level number 10592.485. Retain only as an N0 context/source-quality control; do not use this page as financial evidence or as support for Glob physics.

relational_tests.claims_boundary: This is a lower bound from selected diagnostic tables, not the full current ASD degree. It demonstrates that the common endpoint is reused and that a uniform 1/76 endpoint model is optimistic for significance testing.

relational_tests.scientific_context: Current evaluated W II energy level
relational_tests.claims_boundary: Exact numeric equality across unrelated contexts carries zero relational/physical evidence weight and is retained to test source-aware false-positive suppression.
